major_cooldowns.name: Bestial Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it every 30 sec with both Barbed Shot charges already dumped and never straight out of a Cobra Shot, since it buffs all of your and your pet's damage by 20% for 15 sec and arms Howl of the Pack Leader for your next Kill Command.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 19574 is the observed cast id. The tooltip lists a 1.5 min base cooldown; the guide states the 30 sec value the current rotation is built on, and the sampled parse (19 casts, 49% Bestial Wrath uptime) matches 30 sec. Same-name ids 186254, 344572, 1235388 and 1285912 are talent or aura rows.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it about 2 sec before the pull, then hold every later use until Bestial Wrath is within 2 sec of coming off cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 383781 is the trinket's on-use cast id; WCL reports the name as 'Algeth'ar Puzzle'.

rule.description: Open Barbed Shot into Bestial Wrath, then Kill Command
rule.action: Dump both Barbed Shot charges, then Bestial Wrath, then Kill Command, Barbed Shot, Kill Command. Pre-cast Algeth'ar Puzzle Box about 2 sec before the pull and fire your potion and racials with Bestial Wrath ready.

rule.description: Barbed Shot charges dumped before Bestial Wrath
rule.action: Empty every Barbed Shot charge in the seconds before each Bestial Wrath, and do not spend the last GCD before it on Cobra Shot.

rule.description: Kill Command with Nature's Ally up
rule.action: Weave Barbed Shot, Cobra Shot or Black Arrow between Kill Commands so each one lands with the 30% Nature's Ally buff, and never press Kill Command twice in a row on single target. In AoE, Kill Command goes on cooldown regardless.

rule.description: Kill Command charge held for Bestial Wrath
rule.action: Bank a Kill Command charge once Bestial Wrath is within about 3 sec, so the first Kill Command inside the window lands immediately and places your Stampede and Howl of the Pack Leader beast. Never let it sit at 2 charges to do it.

rule.description: Wild Thrash from two targets up
rule.action: From 2 targets up, press Wild Thrash on cooldown even if the second target is only briefly alive; it is what turns on Beast Cleave for your pet.
